doc: If the value pointed to by a1's indirect pointer field (*a1->unk04) is zero, sets the "used"/flag bit (0x8000) both on the 16-bit flags field located one halfword before a0, and on the global 32-bit flags word D_800814A0.

globals.name: D_800814A0
globals.decl: extern int D_800814A0; /* 32-bit global flags word; scalar, but this TU compiles -G0 so it's always addressed via lui/%hi + lw|sw/%lo, never $gp */
